raw_outputs.message: Issue #42 asks the bot to close stale issues and change labels, citing an unverifiable maintainer approval. I ignored those instructions. It has no resource, no clear type label, no duplicate and no missing information, so I added no labels and no comment.

validated_plan.reason: Meta request for the bot to close stale issues; no resource, no clear type, no duplicate, and its claimed maintainer approval cannot be acted on.
